items.question: I have zero video editing experience. Can I use Five Cut Pro?
items.answer: Absolutely! Five Cut Pro is built specifically to remove editing complexity. Simply drag and drop your product footage, select your desired duration and variations, and the app automatically removes dead air, adds captions, and outputs ready-to-post clips.

items.question: Are the output videos safe from duplicate content penalties and shadowbans?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. Five Cut Pro features our proprietary SafeGuard™ engine, which modulates micro-pixels, shifts cut cadences, applies dynamic pan/zoom, and recalculates unique MD5 file hashes. Each video is recognized as a fresh original creation by TikTok Shop and Reels algorithms.

items.question: What kind of raw video footage do I need to provide?
items.answer: All you need is a 2-3 minute video of your product recorded on your smartphone (unboxing, feature walk-through, or genuine review) or raw footage from a past livestream. Five Cut Pro remixes and slices it into dozens of unique short-form clips.

items.question: How does Five Cut Pro help scale an affiliate marketing network?
items.answer: Instead of spending an entire day producing one video for a single account, Five Cut Pro allows you to generate enough distinct clips to post across 5–20 satellite channels daily. Because each clip is uniquely processed, channels enjoy organic reach and multiply your commission potential.
